blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.orderEdit` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method updates an added item in the order edit by the ID of the item's `ITEM_ADD` action.

Every item has an `actions` property, whose value is an array of actions.
You can check the action's name using its `action` property, and use the value of the `id` property.

to the [Update Item](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#order-edits\_postordereditsiditemsaction\_id)
API route.
